paper_metadata.title: High-temperature creep behavior of gamma Ti-48Al-2Cr-2Nb alloy additively manufactured by electron beam melting

evidence.quote: In this study, a gamma Ti-48Al-2Cr-2Nb alloy was manufactured using EBM, and its microstructure and high-temperature creep behaviors were investigated.

evidence.quote: The EBM-built Ti-48Al-2Cr-2Nb alloy was confirmed to have a few microsized phases, which are suspected of α2, in some grain boundaries, along with an equiaxed γ phase (Fig. 2(a)). According to Weertman et al. [43], the creep mechanism is dominated by grain-boundary sliding at n =2, by dislocation glide at n = 3, and by dislocation climb at n = 5. When evaluating the creep mechanism of the two samples according to the estimated stress exponent (n), it was assumed that the creep deformation was dominated by dislocation glide and dislocation climb in the case of the EBM-built sample.
For the plasma-melted sample, diffusion creep dominated creep deformation in the low-stress section, and dislocation climb or an additional creep mechanism dominated in the high-stress section.
